reviews.body: @pcbeingused333 thanks, the fix is correct: `predict()` and `decompose()` now share one helper, so both get `devices=[0]` with `accelerator="gpu"` on several GPUs, and `decompose_forecast` is reset when an error happens. NHITS/NBEATS/NBEATSx decompositions are identical to `main`. I checked the multi-GPU logic by patching `torch.cuda.device_count`, since I have no multi-GPU machine. A few changes, see the inline comments.

review_comments.body: This only matches `accelerator == "gpu"`. With `"auto"`, `"cuda"` or a `CUDAAccelerator()` on a multi-GPU host, `predict()` and `decompose()` still get `devices=-1` and run multi-device (checked by patching `device_count`). Now that the guard lives in one helper, please use the same check as `is_gpu_accelerator` in `_fit_distributed`, moved to module level so both call it, and add `"cuda"` to it, so every GPU setting gets `devices=[0]`.

`NLinear` has no decomposition, and the `Trainer` and the datamodule are stubbed, so nothing here runs a real `decompose()`, and no other test in the repo does either. Please add a CPU test with a real `NHITS`/`NBEATS` on AirPassengers. Check that the output shape is `[n_series, n_stacks + 1, h]` and that `d.sum(axis=1)` matches `predict()` (it does on this branch). Then make the model's `forward` raise and check that `decompose_forecast` is `False` afterwards.

This checks two cases in one test by re-patching partway through. Please parametrize over `(accelerator, device_count, expected_devices)`, and include `"auto"` and `"cuda"` with 2 devices once the guard covers them.

comments.body:
Thanks for the review. Done in 0d1b6fb: the GPU check is now a module-level `_is_gpu_accelerator` (also accepts `"cuda"`) shared by `_fit_distributed` and the predict/decompose helper, so `"auto"`/`"cuda"`/`CUDAAccelerator()` on a multi-GPU host get `devices=[0]`. Tests: the device cases are parametrized over `(accelerator, device_count, expected_devices)` including `"auto"` and `"cuda"` with 2 devices, and there is a CPU test with real `NHITS`/`NBEATS` on AirPassengers checking the `[n_series, n_stacks + 1, h]` shape, `sum(axis=1)` against `predict()`, and that `decompose_forecast` is `False` after `forward` raises.

This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
